scope: experimental CrossGL MLIR HIR dialect operation and type fact coverage

operations.role: Owns the admitted shader module and fixture source file provenance.
Carries the compute stage boundary for admitted entry-point fixtures.
Names the canonical HIR entry function and void return type facts.
Records the compute local size without becoming resource lowering.
Carries return statement source locations for admitted compute functions.
Collects the common source-location provenance facts every admitted fixture must preserve before any real MLIR projection is accepted.
Represents straight-line scalar local declarations and their source locations.
Represents admitted scalar arithmetic, casts, comparisons, unary expressions, and assignment result facts.
Separates scalar comparison result parity for the straight-line scalar fixture from generic scalar expression coverage.
Carries set and binding descriptor facts for admitted resource fixtures.
Carries the admitted single non-array float storage-buffer type and access facts.

Catalogs one fixed-size storage-buffer descriptor-array resource with literal descriptor indices; it does not admit runtime descriptor arrays, dynamic indexing, nonuniform indexing, or backend descriptor-indexing policy.

Catalogs one fixed-size sampled texture plus sampler descriptor-array fixture with literal descriptor indices; storage-image descriptor-array facts are cataloged separately, and runtime descriptor arrays, dynamic indexing, nonuniform indexing, and backend descriptor-indexing policy remain blocked.

Catalogs fixed-size storage-image descriptor-array resources in one HIR fixture when the descriptor uses literal indices; it does not admit runtime descriptor arrays, folded-symbolic indexes outside cataloged literal facts, dynamic indexing, nonuniform indexing, storage-image atomics, or backend descriptor-indexing policy.
Carries sampled texture resource type, descriptor, and target-independent metadata facts for the admitted sampled-texture fixture.
Carries standalone sampler resource descriptor, comparison role, and target-independent metadata facts for the admitted sampled-texture fixture.
Represents the admitted explicit-LOD sampled texture expression that combines a sampled texture and sampler resource without lowering to target instructions.
Carries direct storage-image resource type, descriptor, format, dimension, read_write access, and target-independent metadata facts for the admitted storage-image fixture.
Represents direct storage-image load calls as report-only HIR dialect shapes without lowering to target instructions.
Represents direct storage-image store calls as report-only HIR dialect shapes while preserving source and resource facts.
Represents the structured-if fixture's storage-buffer read fact only.
Represents admitted storage-buffer writes while preserving descriptor and source facts.
Represents the single admitted structured if/else branch and branch condition facts.

blockedCoverage.reason: Direct sampled texture plus sampler LOD facts, direct read_write storage-image load/store facts, one fixed storage-buffer descriptor-array catalog fixture, one fixed sampled texture plus sampler descriptor-array catalog fixture, and one literal-index fixed storage-image descriptor-array catalog fixture are admitted; dynamic or nonuniform storage-image descriptor indexing, access-qualified storage-image arrays, storage-image atomics, compare helpers, and manual texture intrinsics remain blocked.

Only fixed literal storage-buffer, sampled texture/sampler, and storage-image descriptor-array indices from admitted catalog fixtures are report-only evidence; runtime descriptor arrays, dynamic indexes, folded-symbolic indexes outside cataloged literal facts, nonuniform indexing metadata, and backend descriptor-indexing policy remain blocked.
Production backend policy, package schemas, and target legalization remain outside Milestone 7 experiment scope.
